description: This file defines the ProjectMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It implements menu configuration logic for the project menu, specifically overriding the screen to 'viewProjects'.

classes.name: ProjectMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the project menu for the OrangeHRM Time module by overriding the screen to 'viewProjects'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current module and screen to 'viewProjects' by using getCurrentModuleAndScreen().
